name: Pretzels (Soft)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 package yeast (¼ oz active dry yeast, 2¼ tsp dry yeast, or one 0.6 oz yeast cake)

steps: Dissolve the yeast in the water.
Mix in the salt, sugar, and flour.
Knead the dough until it is smooth.
Roll out (do not cut) a blob of dough until it is a rope about 18 inches long.

If a traditional shape is desired: Make a loop with the middle of the dough, crossing the dough over itself at about the 15% and 85% areas. Give this contact point a 180° twist, then flip it (and the ends) over toward the middle of the dough piece so that the ends overlap the more-central part at about the 45% and 55% areas.
Sprinkle coarse salt onto the egg.

culture.text: A pretzel is a type of baked pastry made from dough that is commonly shaped into a knot. The traditional pretzel shape is a distinctive symmetrical form, with the ends of a long strip of dough intertwined and then twisted back onto itself in a particular way. Today, pretzels come in various shapes, textures, and colors, but the original soft pretzel remains one of the most common pretzel types.
